title: Starboard: a permanent macOS terminal beside your Dock, real zsh, always visible, never steals focus
description:
Starboard is a macOS terminal that sits permanently beside your Dock, tracking its height and position live. Not a Quake-style drop-down: there's no hotkey, no summon and dismiss cycle, and it never takes focus. It shows on every Space including over full-screen apps, running a real persistent zsh login shell, so directory and history carry across commands. Command E grows it upward to full height when output needs the room. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/palamim/starboard
